text:
liam_partnerships: Heads-up — AuroraGrid added a new marketplace listing 'TPU-Rack-XL' but finance flagged the tax classification (hardware vs service) and EDI vendor ID mismatch. Deal desk put the quote into review.

rachel_finance: we can't book the order until vendor EDI matches our vendor master (they sent vendor id AG-92; we have AG-002). also need tax code (physical good = 0% VAT reversal? not sure for EU).

tom_salesops: partner portal shows two SKUs: TPU-Rack-XL (hardware) + Onsite-Install-8h (service). Partner pushed a single combined PO. That confuses our ERP mapping. Can partner split PO lines?

liam_partnerships: partner is resistant to splitting — they say marketplace requires a single invoice. They did attach a note: "split billing on request" but didn't include taxbucket/line-level tax codes.

nina_legal: quick check — if it's physical hardware we need shipping/incoterm and risk transfer language. also if the installation requires access to customer data we need an addendum re: data processing during install.

dave_ops: from ops POV, the rack ships to a datacenter and we coordinate racking+burn-in. if procurement thinks it's "digital" we won't be able to claim installation SOW. Need to keep install as a separate invoice or a subcontract PO.

edi-bot: Notice: EDI submit failed — vendor id mismatch (provided: AG-92 | master: AG-002). Message: "Please resubmit with valid vendor id". Reference: EDI-4521.

rachel_finance: timeline: partner must confirm vendor id and provide tax classification and incoterm by EOD Monday or we'll decline the marketplace purchase via automated flow.

tom_salesops: workaround: can we create a short-term 'internal vendor alias' for AG-92 so revenue ops can process? That adds procurement reconciliation but buys time.

liam_partnerships: creating alias requires AP review. I'm worried about duplicate vendor payments. Only do if partner agrees to supplier attest and W9/EU equivalent.

nina_legal: I'll draft a 1-paragraph marketplace amendment: (1) split billing allowed for hardware vs services; (2) vendor attests tax id and accepts our vendor onboarding terms; (3) incoterm clarified as DDP or buyer pickup. Share for review.

dave_ops: note for install scheduling — we need 4-week lead time after shipment confirmation. flagging to delivery team.

liam_partnerships: action items: @nina_legal to drop amendment by 10am tomorrow; @tom_salesops to ask partner for corrected EDI + VAT docs; @rachel_finance to tentatively hold funds and update AP queue. I'll loop AuroraGrid account manager.

tom_salesops: pinging AuroraGrid AM now 4e9. will update thread when they reply.

liam_partnerships: thanks everyone. react with :eyes: if you see any missing risk. If partner refuses amendment, we'll escalate to GCP partner ops and consider delayed marketplace publish.
